Definition: from G4253 and G5500; to elect in advance:--choose before.
BiblicalUsage: Procheirotoneo means to elect in advance, to choose before. Peter tells Cornelius that God raised Jesus and showed him openly, not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the witnesses were chosen before they saw, and seeing was the gift that made them witnesses.
